title: A Neyman-Orthogonalization Approach to the Incidental Parameter Problem in Likelihood Models
abstract: arXiv:2412.10304v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A popular approach to perform inference on a target parameter in the presence of nuisance parameters is to construct estimating equations that are orthogonal to the nuisance parameters, in the sense that their expected first derivative is zero. Such first-order orthogonalization allows the estimator of the nuisance parameters to converge at a slower-than-parametric rate. It may, however, not suffice when the nuisance parameters are very imprecisely estimated. Leading examples are models for panel and network data that feature fixed effects. In this paper, we show how, in the conditional-likelihood setting, estimating equations can be constructed that are orthogonal to any chosen order q, in that their leading q expected derivatives are zero. This yields estimators of target parameters that are unaffected by the presence of nuisance parameters to order q. In an empirical illustration, we apply our method to a fixed-effect model of tea

translated_title: 似然模型中偶然参数问题的尼曼正交化方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2412.10304v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：在存在干扰参数的情况下，对目标参数进行推断的一种流行方法是构造与干扰参数正交的估计方程，即其期望一阶导数为零。这种一阶正交化允许干扰参数的估计量以慢于参数速率的速度收敛。然而，当干扰参数估计非常不精确时，这可能不够。主要例子是带有固定效应的面板数据和网络数据模型。在本文中，我们展示了在条件似然设置下，如何构造与任意选择阶数q正交的估计方程，即其前q阶期望导数为零。这产生了不受干扰参数存在影响的目标参数估计量，达到q阶。在实证示例中，我们将我们的方法应用于茶的固定效应模型。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在似然模型中构造任意阶正交估计方程的方法，使目标参数估计不受干扰参数影响至q阶，解决了固定效应模型中干扰参数估计不精确的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method to construct estimating equations orthogonal to any chosen order q in likelihood models, making target parameter estimates unaffected by nuisance parameters up to order q, addressing the issue of imprecisely estimated nuisance parameters in fixed-effect models.
